messages.author: 829e33684ea2ecd2
messages.subject: Re: rpy2
parts:
Hi Jake,

I've determined what the problem is. I was initially getting the same libRLpack.so errors you were getting when running the tests.

The issue is that you need to tell R where to find the libRLaPack.so library. One way to do that is to set the 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH' variable in your Linux environment:

              %export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib64/MRO-3.2.3/R-3.2.3/lib64/R/lib


Then, rerun the rpy2 tests and they should run successfully.



Stephen Weller
Microsoft R Open Technical Support
